title: I read 1900 Books, these 4 will make you rich
description:
✅ Get your FREE Executive Assistant Playbook here: https://go.danmartell.com/4x1mjsU

After 1900+ books on money, business, and wealth, I can tell you most of them are noise.

A small handful actually move the needle on income, and the rest are entertainment dressed up as education. In this video, I'm pulling back the curtain on the 4 books that personally shaped how I built and exited multiple companies, and exactly why they matter at different stages of your wealth journey. Stick around till the end because the last one is the reason most high performers quietly burn out before they ever get rich.
